summary: VitaGuide Symptom-Tagebuch (diary) feature testing completed. Backend: 7/7 tests passed (100%) after fixing upsert bug. Frontend: All critical flows verified and working. Diary navigation, entry inputs (mood/sleep/stress ratings, water counter, exercise chips, notes), save functionality, and trends tab with LLM analysis all working correctly. rca_of_issue.bug: Diary upsert not preserving entry ID when updating same date
rca_of_issue.root_cause: In server.py POST /api/diary endpoint, the entry object was created with a new UUID (line 618) BEFORE checking if an entry already existed for today (line 629). Even though line 632 attempted to fix it by setting entry['id'] = existing['id'], the MongoDB update had already executed with the NEW UUID in the $set operation.
reproduction_steps: 1. POST /api/diary with mood=2 (creates entry with ID abc123)
2. POST /api/diary again same day with mood=5 (should update, but created new ID xyz456)
3. Verify via GET /api/diary?days=1 - entry has different ID
rca_of_issue.fix_applied: Moved the existing entry check to BEFORE creating the entry object. Now: 1) Check if entry exists for today, 2) Create entry object with existing['id'] if found, else new UUID, 3) Execute update or insert. This ensures ID is preserved during upsert.
rca_of_issue.verification: Reran pytest test_diary_upsert_same_date_updates_entry - now passes. Entry ID remains same across multiple POSTs for same date.
